page.overview:
Who is Barbos?

Barbos is the mother of all the Lurchins in the Donkey Kong franchise. She first appears in Donkey Kong Country 3: Dixie Kong's Double Trouble!, as the boss of Razor Ridge, then in Donkey Kong Land III as the boss of Cape Codswallop. In Donkey Kong Country 3s Game Boy Advance remake, Barbos was repurposed as the boss of Pacifica, in favor of Razor Ridge's version-exclusive boss Kroctopus. In all three appearances, Barbos is fought by Enguarde, given that Dixie Kong and Kiddy Kong are incapable of fighting underwater enemies on their own.
